items.title: "Kid Thomas" Valentine Interview, 1959-11-08
items.q: Wooden Joe played with us a long time. ... me and Wooden Joe, alright.

ctx.x: Did you use two trumpets? Seems like somebody told me they played trumpet with you for a while. You know who played with me? Wooden Joe. Oh yeah.

Wooden Joe played two trumpets with us? I used to, we used to play parade, we had a brass band, we had a pretty good brass band. Well, me, me, me and Wooden Joe, alright. Wooden Joe played with us a long time. And uh, Russ, he played trumpet with us at Moulin Rouge during the time of the war. He was in the Navy. Who was that then?

items.title: "Kid Thomas" Valentine Interview, 1959-11-08
items.q: I said, of course, I said, listen, this band is not my band. I said, John is the manager of this band... So, when I came there, all the boys was sitting on the porch... I started to go back... Remus said, no, don't do that... John fired him. John got rid of him. John wanted us to play.

ctx.x: I remember you told me once about how they-

Yeah, man, that old boy Manny, or what it was, Manny Gabriel, he come in there, he ogden, he. Poor Joe Nicholas without disturbing him, poor Joe Nicholas. He want to come talk with Joe Nicholas and Joe, with Joe Nicholas. That man could, who? That man should play parade by himself. That's why they call him Wooden Joe. So, he's got about three or four trumpets. He break the line and go up there and tell the fella what then told Joe Nicholas, what he ain't doing. And buoy me up, you know what I mean? So, I told…
You wasn't getting nothing out of that.
